environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not BLOCK) to allow long department names; (2) Priority 200 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action, inspecting QueryString, Body, and SingleHeader 'cookie' field match scope; (3) Priority 300 - custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per source IP. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary that prevents any network egress except to the VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs, and the Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with the task running in awsvpc mode within a private subnet with no internet gateway route. The SQLite database is mounted from an EFS volume with encryption at rest enabled.

config.infrastructure: AWS ALB -> ECS Fargate (awsvpc, private subnet)
config.network: private subnet, no IGW, NAT only to VPC endpoints
config.task_role_permission_boundary: deny all except logs:PutLogEvents to VPC endpoint
